verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms FIDO2/WebAuthn compatibility and specific integration guides for Azure AD/Entra ID joined Windows and Microsoft applications, which supports IdP-level enforcement for Microsoft environments. However, there is no evidence of explicit Okta or Google Workspace admin-policy integration guides, nor documentation of fleet-wide policy enforcement, provisioning, or centralized key management consoles for admins. Missing for 10: Okta/Google Workspace specific integration docs, admin policy-enforcement tooling, fleet provisioning/management console evidence.
